question: How do I create a FOREO user account?
answer: Creating a FOREO user account is simple and can be done through the FOREO mobile app. Here’s how: Download the FOREO App. Open the app and tap "Sign Up". Enter your email, create a password, and provide your details. Verify your email using the code sent to your inbox. Log in and register your FOREO device.

question: How do I change my password?
answer: If you remember your current password, log into your account via the app, and click on the “Me” icon in the bottom right corner. When you scroll down select the option “Change Password”. If you forgot the password, try logging in to your account via app or the website, and select "Forgot your password?". Enter your registered email address and submit, check your email for a password reset code and use it to create a new password and log in again.

question: I cannot login to my account. What should I do?
answer: Make sure that you’re trying to log in with the correct email address. In case you’re trying to log in with a different email than the one you registered with, you won’t be able to log in. In case you logged in with your AppleID, you will only be able to log in with it in the future. In case you’re trying to log in with your personal email, it won’t be accepted. If you’re still not able to log in, feel free to contact us by clicking on this link .

question: Where can I find my orders/purchase history?
answer: Log in/open FOREO For You App — go to the “Me” icon in the bottom right corner — click on “My orders”. There you will have a list of all the orders connected with your FOREO account. *In case you created the order as anonymous/guest your purchase won’t be shown in your order history.

question: How can I delete my account?
answer: Log into your account via the app, and click on the “Me” icon in the bottom right corner. When you scroll down, select the option “Account Cancellation”, and you will receive a form to contact our Customer Care team who will delete your account.

question: What is FAQ Subscription?
answer: FAQ Subscription is an additional paid subscription service in FOREO For You and FAQ Swiss apps that provides current and new FOREO and FAQ customers with new or extended features and benefits. It is divided into three tiers: FAQ Essential, FAQ Care and FAQ Care Plus. Each tier has its own additional benefits offered. Important: FAQ subscription is not mandatory for using the device, it is offering additional benefits.

question: How do I change/update my card information for my FAQ Subscription?
answer: You can update your payment method information following these steps: Log in to your FOREO account. Go to the device with a subscription. Click on the “Care Plus FAQ” option. At the bottom, select "Manage plan". A page will open where you can check the last 4 digits of your card, on the right side click "Edit". Click "Update Payment Method", enter the required information, then select "Confirm" and that's it!

question: Where can I see my registered devices?
answer: Open your FOREO For You App - In the top left corner you will see the “Add device” button and then on the right all of your registered devices will be shown.

answer: You can remove the registration from your device by entering your FOREO For You app, clicking on your device, going to "Device Info" and then on the top right you can see three small dots (headphone icon near it). Click on it, and press "Remove device" and then press OK.

question: I am unable to place an order. What can I do?
answer: Please try the following if you are unable to place an order: - Please check if all your card details were inserted correctly and if your card is valid. - Try the payment process again to see if it goes through. - Place an order using a computer instead of a smartphone/tablet. - Try Mozilla Firefox, as our website tends to work best with this internet browser. - If your payment is still not successful, please contact our support and provide us with a screenshot.

question: Can I cancel my order once it has been placed?
answer: Unfortunately, you won’t be able to cancel your order on your own. If you wish to cancel it, you can contact our support team and check if it is still possible to do so. In case your order has already been shipped, we are unable to cancel it at this stage, but you can refuse the package or return it to us after it has been received. It should be returned to us unopened within 14 days from the date of delivery. Please contact us with the picture of the unopened package and your order number.

question: What are the accepted payment methods?
answer: FOREO accepts the following forms of payment for online purchases: For delivery to European Union countries: Visa, Mastercard / Eurocard For delivery outside the European Union: Major credit cards including Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Diner’s Club, Discovery. As soon as your purchase has been verified, an order confirmation will be emailed to you.

question: Will my credit card information be stored?
answer: To safeguard your security, FOREO does not store any credit card details. Online purchases will be charged to your credit card when you submit your order. However, the transaction will only be put through once we have verified your card details, received credit authorization and confirmed the availability of stock. You will be notified by email if for any reason we are unable to complete your order.

question: How can I apply a discount code?
answer: Once you have selected your order, and you go to the first stage where you see your items, you will see “Coupon code” in small writing, click on this and a field will appear for a coupon code to be entered . Add the code exactly how it is into the box and click "+". Once applied, your cart will update with the current code discount, and you can proceed to payment. Please note the following: - Coupon codes cannot be used in conjunction with any other discounts or deals that are currently running on our site, unless stated otherwise. - Check that you have entered the correct coupon code to the correct device, as some of our codes can be limited to certain products only. - Multiple codes cannot be used in a single transaction. - Please check that your coupon code is still valid at the time you’re using it. answer: FAQ What are the differences between the LUNA™ 2 and the LUNA™? Available in 5 vibrant colors, it features a 3-zone brush surface that suits all skin types. In addition to a T-Sonic™ Cleansing Mode, the LUNA™ has an Anti-Aging Mode that channels lower-frequency pulsations to reduce the visible signs of aging, has 8 speeds, provides up to 450 uses per full charge and is available in 3 different models according to skin type. Can I use the LUNA™ around the eye area? Yes, the LUNA™ is safe to be used under the eyes to help reduce dark circles and puffiness. We’d recommend to lower the frequency and glide the LUNA™ smooth on the specific area but without pressing too much on the skin. Wash the brush surfaces with soap and water, rinse with clean water and pat dry with a lint-free cloth or towel. We recommend spraying the device with FOREO's Silicone Cleaning Spray and rinsing with warm water afterwards for optimal results. Allow device to air-dry. Can I use the LUNA™ in Anti-Aging Mode with serums and creams? Yes, you can. Using beauty products in combination with LUNA™ provides superior results. Which facial cleansers can be used with the LUNA™? You can use any facial cleanser with the LUNA™, but to keep your device in optimal condition, avoid using clay-based, silicone-based or grainy cleansers as they may damage the silicone touch-points. What are the differences between the 3 brushes? LUNA™ Ultra-Sensitive The wave formation of closely packed, smooth silicone ridges is designed to minimize abrasion for the most sensitive skin, offering cleansing that's highly effective and extra-gentle at the same time. LUNA™ Sensitive/Normal This brush surface features thinner touch-points for gentle cleansing, with an area of thicker touch-points grouped towards the top of the device for deeper, precision cleansing of areas around the nose, ears and hairline. LUNA™ Combination Up to 80% of this brush surface is covered with thinner touch-points for gentle cleansing, with two additional waves of thicker touch-points for the stronger cleansing of oily patches. Getting started Charging your LUNA™ Your LUNA™ is rechargeable with its included charger or USB cable. One hour of charging delivers a full charge which lasts up to 7 months of use. • While charging, the indicator will flash repeatedly • When the battery is full, the indicator will emit a steady glow • When the battery is low, the indicator will start to flash repeatedly Using your LUNA™ • Dampen your face apply your regular cleanser. We suggest using FOREO’s DAY and NIGHT CLEANSERS for optimal results. • Wet the device and press the center button to activate its Cleansing Mode and press once more to put it on Standby, at which time you can rinse and dry your face. • When the device is on Standby, its indicator light will emit a steady glow. • Press again to activate the Anti-Aging Mode, then press for a final time to deactivate the device. Features of the LUNA™ • 2 Modes: Cleansing Mode and Anti-Aging Mode • Cleansing Mode (with touch-point brush) – 1 minute for cleansing routine. • Anti-Aging Mode (with ridge surface) – 1 minute for diminishing fine lines and wrinkles. • 8 intensities for maximum comfort: the intensity of each mode can be increased or decreased with the + or – buttons. The Cleansing Mode has a memory function that will remember your speed preference for the next time it is used. The Anti-Aging Mode does not have a memory function; every time it is activated it will be operating on the highest speed. • Integrated timer: pulsations will pause every 15 seconds in Cleansing Mode and every 12 seconds in Anti-Aging Mode to indicate when you should move the device to another area of the face. The device will pause its pulsations 3 times in succession after 1 minute to signify the end of the cleansing routine and again after the anti-aging routine, indicating the end of the entire beauty routine. Your FOREO device will switch itself off after 3 minutes in either mode. • Locking/unlocking: you may lock or unlock the controls by holding down the + and – buttons at the same time

Available in 5 vibrant colors, it features a 3-zone brush surface that suits all skin types. We recommend spraying the device with FOREO's Silicone Cleaning Spray and rinsing with warm water afterwards for optimal results. Allow device to air-dry. Can I use the LUNA™ mini if I have acne, eczema or other skin conditions? We suggest that anyone who suffers from a serious skin condition should consult their dermatologist before using the device.
